steps.en: Install ComfyUI 0.41.2+, the listed node packs and the H3, SAM 3.1 and Qwen models
steps.zh: 装好 ComfyUI 0.41.2+、所列节点包和 H3 等模型

steps.en: Start the patched proxy and the app
steps.zh: 启动打过补丁的代理和应用

steps.en: Drop a video and a character photo, then press Generate
steps.zh: 拖入视频和角色照片，点 Generate

steps.en: Prune the exported graph and check its nodes and model files against ComfyUI
steps.zh: 裁剪导出图，并对照 ComfyUI 检查节点和模型文件

steps.en: Track the person with SAM, turn them into a grey mannequin and render each clip with H3
steps.zh: 用 SAM 跟踪人物，转成灰色人偶，再用 H3 逐段渲染

steps.en: Assemble the final MP4 with the source soundtrack
steps.zh: 拼出保留原声的最终 MP4

value.en: A character-swapped video without hand-wiring a ComfyUI graph for every run
value.zh: 不用每次手接 ComfyUI 节点图，就得到换了角色的视频
